data_sources: NASA Mars Trek (Jezero Crater 5x5 DEM & Slope Grid)
NASA DONKI (Solar Flare Quiet Window C3.4)
NASA OSDR (EVA Metabolic Cost & Crew Physical Readiness)

Flat_Plains.description: Easiest and most power-efficient route, but takes a longer path.

Ice_Patch.description: Slight wheel slip requires extra motor effort.

Mountain.description: Deadly trap! Drains half the Rover's battery in a single step.

scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_1: Digital Elevation Models (DEM) from NASA's Mars Trek show that climbing steep mountains in Jezero Crater consumes vastly more rover energy than flat plains.
scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_2: NASA scientists monitor space weather via DONKI to find quiet solar windows (like C-class) before allowing astronauts to perform Extravehicular Activities (EVAs).
